about: The least number of passing checks each gate may report. tools/floors.js fails a gate whose log has no summary line, reports any failure, or counts fewer passes than its floor here. A gate that crashed, was cut off or was skipped therefore cannot pass.

Raise a floor by editing this file on purpose, in the same change that adds the checks, from a green run. Never lower one to get green. Nothing writes this file.

expected_red_max is the most expected red a gate may print. tools/floors.js fails a gate above its ceiling, and fails a gate that prints an expected red count with no ceiling here, so a failing check cannot be let off as expected red unseen. It drops to 0 in the change that turns the expected reds green.
